learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to make perfect sentences using the friendly helping verbs Is, Am, and Are!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The word Am is very shy. It is only best friends with the word I. We always say I am a good child.
We use Is when we talk about only one person place or thing. He is tall and The bird is flying.
We use Are when we talk about more than one person or thing. You are my friend and They are playing.

fun_activity.title: 🗣️ Talk About Yourself
fun_activity.instructions: Stand in front of a mirror and say three sentences starting with I am. Like I am happy!

quick_recap: ⭐ We always use Am with the pronoun I.
⭐ We use Is for one thing or person.
⭐ We use Are for many things or persons.
